meta.title: The Little Hen and the Pizza
meta.textType: story: a traditional story with repeated lines

paragraphs: On Saturday, Lily and Tom went to Green Hill. Grandma and Grandpa were going to make pizza for lunch. The kitchen smelled of tomatoes and cheese. "Everyone must help," said Grandpa. Tom sat on a chair and looked at the garden. Grandpa smiled and began a story. "Say the words with me, and say no with your head like this," he said.

A little hen wanted to make a big pizza. She was small, but she was strong. "Who will help me with the flour?" she asked. "Not I," said the dog. "Not I," said the cat. "Not I," said the cow. "Then I will do it," said the little hen. She put the flour and some water in a bowl. Lily and Tom said no with their heads and said, "Not I!"

Next, the hen made a salad. "Who will help me with the salad?" she asked. "Not I," said the dog. "Not I," said the cat. "Not I," said the cow. It was a horrible hot day, and the cow was thirsty. Then the hen put the pizza in the oven. The pizza smelled so good.

The animals came to the kitchen. "Can we have some pizza?" they asked. "No," said the hen. "You must help first." The dog and the cat washed the plates, and the cow cleaned the table. After that, they all ate the pizza and the salad together. Grandpa finished the story, and Tom laughed and got up from his chair. "I will help!" he said. "I will wash the vegetables." Grandpa smiled and gave him a big bowl. Lily put cheese on the next pizza. Everyone laughed.
text.summary: Grandpa tells Lily and Tom a story about a little hen. No animal helps her make a pizza, and she says that everyone must help first.
